items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: Manuel Marlowe, Leo Marlowe, Robbie Kirsch... Was in your band when you got married

ctx.x: Let me get everything. Right. Papa, who was in your band when you got married about that time? Who was in your band when you got married? When I got married? Mm-hmm.
Manuel Marlowe, Leo Marlowe, Robbie Kirsch, Martin Kirsch, Gussie Zinneman, and the Chinaman, and... Was that King Martin? Yeah. Kit Martin, Vega, Buck A., and the Shields.
So many of them. I couldn't remember. Yeah. Well, do you remember when Dave Hennessy got killed? He was the chief of police? Oh, yes.

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: So this Manuel Marlowe, one of the leaders of my band

ctx.x: Let them have their fun. Listen, how... There's a magazine section there when he was a couple of years old, I don't know how much, a couple of weeks ago. He states then that he had to hide a cornet that he had in the well in his home. Yes. How could he do such a thing? When the first... He didn't even know how to hold a cornet in his mouth when he played with... He used to sit in the Elmire Pleasure Ground... Well, he did. ...in the park. And Manuel Marlowe is the man that showed him how to blow the cornet.

He used to, you know, play, but not anywhere as good, you understand? So this Manuel Marlowe, one of the leaders of my band, I had a couple of bands, of course, the leaders in all these bands. I don't get it.
How they can tell such a thing?

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: I had Manuel Marlowe, he used to run a band himself... him and Manuel Marlowe, in fact, were the first two kids that I picked up on horn.

ctx.x: Yeah. See? Mm-hmm. So, you had a lot of managing things to do. You had to manage. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Well, you see, I wouldn't have to do

all the managing myself. Now, like I had Manuel Marlowe, he used to run a band himself, poor band himself, Manuel Marlowe, you see, and I like Vega and my son, they'd run a band, you see. They'd manage it and all. All they'd do is they'd get the instructions from me. See, I'd give them the instructions and give them the contract and everything else. Well, they'd collect and sign and give receipts and all that sort of stuff, illegally, you know what I mean? They wouldn't need me there then, you see. I see.
